summary: A strong daily you can play by artist name: casual 8, fan 9, and every miss shows a figure. Hold it for one matcher fix: typing just "tour" offers top-10 tours as free choices until the whole top 10 is found.
reasons: Last cycle's traps are fixed ("the weekend", "guns and roses", "m72", "renaissance tour", "farewell tour", "ed sheeran divide"). Swift, Coldplay, Sheeran, Styles and Elton are gimmes, The Weeknd and U2 take thought, Metallica and Springsteen are fair stretches. Casual 8 (9 if they go back for Ed Sheeran's second offered tour), fan 9.

Lives go fast (both players ran out), but on near misses that teach: Pink #11, Guns N' Roses #12, Beyonce #13, the Stones #16, Madonna's Sticky & Sweet at $411M. Pink beating Beyonce and The Weeknd at #3 are good surprises.

"tour", the word in nearly every answer, offers four top-10 tours at a time as free choices and keeps doing it as they are found; "world tour" offers M72 and Music of the Spheres. The list's own noun hands out the key, in classic and in Blitz.
fixes: Answer-key leak (src/game/match.ts, coordinator): "tour" and "the tour" are read as part of every name and offered as choices: After Hours til Dawn / Mathematics / Music of the Spheres / Eras, then Divide, 360°, M72, Springsteen and Love On Tour as earlier ones are found, all free. "world tour" offers Las Mujeres / M72 / Music of the Spheres / Renaissance. A guess made only of the list's noun words should get "be more specific": add "tour" and "tours" to GENERIC, or let natural() go vague when a word part fits more than VAGUE_ABOVE entries even if the top ones are ranked. Keep "renaissance tour", "1989 tour", "m72 tour" and "harry styles tour" working. Guard with a test on this list and a validate.ts check that no puzzle's noun word offers or accepts a top-10 answer.

The reveal never says whose tour 360° Tour (#7, U2) or M72 World Tour (#9, Metallica) is: the names don't, and neither do their facts (Divide Tour's fact doesn't name Ed Sheeran either). Players answer by artist, so a casual who missed U2 learns nothing from "360° Tour". Name the artist in those three facts in scripts/facts/concert-tours.json, or show the table's Artist column on the reveal (a types.ts change).

Artist + tour fails for short artist names: "u2 vertigo", "u2 joshua tree" and "bts arirang" get "isn't an answer for this list" although Vertigo Tour, The Joshua Tree Tours 2017 & 2019 and Arirang World Tour (#19) are on it ("metallica worldwired" and "shakira las mujeres" work). leadingName skips leading names under four letters; let an exact artist alias lead at any length. Free in classic, but the message is wrong and it loses Blitz points.

Not recognized: "after hours till dawn" (the usual "till" spelling of #3), "mots" ("MOTS Tour" is an alias) and "sheeran" alone ("springsteen" works). Add "After Hours till Dawn", "MOTS" and "Sheeran" (on both Ed Sheeran tours).
